definition_zh: 继续进行；前进；着手；推进；（法律）起诉；发出（古义）
definition_en: to continue or move forward, especially after a pause or as the next step
core_image: 一条路在岔口干等，绿灯亮起后脚步重新向前
scene: 演示暂停后，主持人拿起翻页笔。The host said we may proceed to the next slide, and the screen changed as soon as the button was pressed.
sceneCN: 这里 proceed 是「继续进行、进入下一步」（第 1 个义项：停顿之后接着往下走）；句意：主持人说我们可以继续看下一张幻灯片，按钮一按屏幕就换了画面。图中可辨识物件：投影屏、翻页笔、讲台、水杯、听众；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 继续进行；前进；着手；推进；（法律）起诉

senses.title: Continue after a pause
senses.definition: to continue doing something after stopping or waiting
senses.definitionCN: 停止或等待之后继续做某事
senses.example: After a short break, we proceeded with the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 短暂休息后，我们继续开会。
senses.why: Latin procedere means 'go forward': pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'go'. The word assumes something has stopped and now resumes its motion.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 procedere 意为“向前走”：pro-“向前”加 cedere“走”。这个词假定某物曾停下，现在重新开始运动。

senses.title: Move forward physically
senses.definition: to move onward in space
senses.definitionCN: 在空间中向前移动
senses.example: The procession proceeded slowly down the street.
senses.exampleCN: 队伍沿街缓慢行进。
senses.why: This is the literal core: feet or wheels moving along a path. Everything abstract in English is borrowed from this simple forward motion.
senses.whyCN: 这是字面的核心：脚或轮子沿路移动。英语里一切抽象义都从这个简单的向前运动借来。

senses.title: Begin or undertake an action
senses.definition: to start doing something as the next step
senses.definitionCN: 作为下一步开始做某事
senses.example: We will proceed to build the prototype.
senses.exampleCN: 我们将着手制作原型。
senses.why: Starting and continuing are close: the next step is both the end of waiting and the beginning of action. The infinitive after proceed marks what is undertaken.
senses.whyCN: 开始与继续很近：下一步既是等待的结束，也是行动的开始。proceed 后接不定式，标记着手的内容。

senses.title: Carry out a plan or process
senses.definition: to carry on with a plan, process, or procedure
senses.definitionCN: 继续推进计划、过程或程序
senses.example: The committee proceeded according to the rules.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会按规则推进。
senses.why: Institutions need a script: proceed means to follow the prescribed steps. The word becomes procedural, which is why procedure is its close relative.
senses.whyCN: 机构需要脚本：proceed 意为按既定步骤走。这个词变得程序化，所以 procedure 是它的近亲。

senses.title: Make progress
senses.definition: to advance toward a goal
senses.definitionCN: 朝目标推进
senses.example: The project is proceeding well.
senses.exampleCN: 项目进展顺利。
senses.why: Forward motion becomes achievement: if the path advances, the work advances. English uses the same metaphor for time, work, and journeys.
senses.whyCN: 向前运动变成成就：路推进，工作就推进。英语用同一个隐喻说时间、工作与旅程。

senses.title: Go on to the next item
senses.definition: in formal speech, to move to the next topic or stage
senses.definitionCN: 正式讲话中，进入下一个话题或阶段
senses.example: Let us proceed to the second question.
senses.exampleCN: 让我们进入第二个问题。
senses.why: Meetings rank items in order. Proceed is the verbal signal that one item is closed and the next opened, a procedural gate rather than a physical one.
senses.whyCN: 会议把议题排序。proceed 是“上一项已关、下一项已开”的口头信号，是程序的关口而非物理关口。

senses.title: Take legal action against
senses.definition: to start or continue a legal action against someone
senses.definitionCN: 对某人开始或继续法律诉讼
senses.example: The company proceeded against the supplier.
senses.exampleCN: 公司对供应商提起诉讼。
senses.why: Law is a path with formal steps: filing, hearing, judgment. To proceed against someone is to set that machinery in motion.
senses.whyCN: 法律是一条有正式步骤的路：提交、听证、判决。proceed against 某人，就是启动这套机器。

senses.title: Come forth or issue from (archaic)
senses.definition: in older usage, to originate or come out from a source
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：从某个源头产生或出来
senses.example: Light proceeds from the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 光来自太阳。
senses.why: The Latin verb could mean 'come out of'. English kept this for a time: what proceeds from a source moves out of it. Modern usage prefers arise or issue.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词可指“从……出来”。英语保留过一阵：proceed from 某源，就是从它里面出来。现代多用 arise 或 issue。

senses.title: (Of an event) go forward
senses.definition: of an event or plan, to take place as arranged
senses.definitionCN: 事件或计划按安排进行
senses.example: The wedding will proceed despite the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管下雨，婚礼仍将举行。
senses.why: An event is treated as an object on a path: it can be stopped, delayed, or allowed to proceed. The word grants permission to the future.
senses.whyCN: 事件被当作路上的物件：它可以被停下、推迟，或被允许 proceed。这个词是在给未来发放许可。

intro.en: Proceed is a pure motion word: pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'go'. English borrowed it in the late 14c. and then extended the walk into meetings, projects, and lawsuits.
intro.cn: proceed 是一个纯粹的运动词：pro-“向前”加 cedere“走”。英语在 14 世纪末借入，随后把这场行走扩展到会议、项目与诉讼。

items.en: First recorded with the sense 'go forward, continue one's course'.
items.cn: 最早记录为“向前走、继续行程”。

items.en: From Latin procedere 'go forward, advance, come forth' = pro- 'forward' + cedere 'go, yield'.
items.cn: 来自拉丁语 procedere“向前走、推进、出现”= pro-“向前”+ cedere“走、让”。

items.en: cedere also gives cede, accede, concede, exceed, precede, and succeed. The base is about going or yielding, and the prefix pro- points the going forward.
items.cn: cedere 还生成 cede、accede、concede、exceed、precede、succeed。词基关乎走或让，前缀 pro- 把方向指向前。

items.en: The legal sense 'begin or carry on an action at law' develops, producing proceedings and procedure.
items.cn: 法律义“开始或继续诉讼”发展出来，产生 proceedings 与 procedure。

items.en: Modern English uses proceed for meetings, projects, and formal sequences, always with a sense of a path resumed.
items.cn: 现代英语用 proceed 指会议、项目与正式流程，始终带有“路径重新开始”的意味。

note.en: The first group shares the cedere root; the second is about verbs that also mean continuing or advancing.
note.cn: 第一组共享 cedere 词根，第二组看同样表示“继续”或“推进”的动词。

entries.definition: to come before. It uses prae- 'before' + cedere.
entries.definitionCN: 在……之前。它用 prae-“在前”+ cedere。

entries.definition: to come after; to achieve a goal. It is sub- 'under, next' + cedere.
entries.definitionCN: 随后；成功。它是 sub-“在其后”+ cedere。

entries.definition: a set of steps for doing something. It is proceed plus -ure.
entries.definitionCN: 做某事的步骤。它是 proceed 加 -ure。

entries.definition: to keep doing something without stopping. It stresses duration, not direction.
entries.definitionCN: 不停顿地做下去。它强调持续，而非方向。

entries.definition: to move forward or make progress. It is closer to the physical sense of proceed.
entries.definitionCN: 向前移动或取得进展。它更接近 proceed 的物理义。

entries.definition: to develop toward a better state. It stresses improvement, not sequence.
entries.definitionCN: 朝更好状态发展。它强调改善，而非次序。

normalIntro.en: Real links: Latin cedere 'go', the pro- 'forward' prefix, the proceed/precede/succeed trio, and the legal use proceed against.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：拉丁语 cedere“走”、前缀 pro-“向前”、proceed/precede/succeed 三词，以及法律用法 proceed against。

normal.en: Cedere means 'go' and pro- means 'forward': proceed is to go forward.
normal.cn: cedere 意为“走”，pro- 意为“向前”：proceed 就是向前走。

normal.en: Precede is prae- plus cedere, 'go before'; succeed is sub- plus cedere, 'go next'. The prefix sets the position.
normal.cn: precede 是 prae- 加 cedere，“走在前面”；succeed 是 sub- 加 cedere，“接着走”。前缀定位置。

normal.en: To proceed assumes a pause: something stopped and now resumes. It is motion after a gap.
normal.cn: proceed 假定有停顿：某物停下，现在重启。它是间隙之后的运动。

normal.en: In meetings, proceed is a procedural gate: one item closes, the next opens.
normal.cn: 会议中，proceed 是程序关口：一项关闭，下一项开启。

normal.en: To proceed against someone is to start the legal machinery walking.
normal.cn: proceed against 某人，就是让法律机器开始行走。

abstract.en: Forward is both a direction and a value: progress borrows its authority from the geometry of motion.
abstract.cn: 向前既是方向也是价值：进步从运动的几何学借来权威。

abstract.en: Every procedure is a path made repeatable, so that anyone can walk it without knowing the ground.
abstract.cn: 每一种程序都是被做成可重复的路径，好让任何人都能走而不必认识地形。

abstract.en: Permission to proceed is permission to let time continue; a meeting pauses the world and then releases it.
abstract.cn: 允许 proceed，就是允许时间继续；会议暂停世界，再把它放行。

examples.en: Please proceed with your report.
examples.cn: 请继续你的报告。

examples.en: We proceeded to the next item on the agenda.
examples.cn: 我们进入议程的下一项。

examples.en: The firm proceeded against the contractor for breach of contract.
examples.cn: 公司以违约为由起诉承包商。

dict_mnemonic.text: “扑若细的”——扑过去，像细线一样一路向前 → proceed 前进、继续进行

root: 拉丁语 procedere“向前走”，由 pro-“向前”+ cedere“走”构成；同族有 cede、precede、succeed、exceed。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of proceed, all one walk. The walk can resume after a break, advance in space, start a task, follow a procedure, enter the next agenda item, or enter a courtroom.
sensesIntro.cn: proceed 的九个义项，都是同一场行走。这场行走可以在休息后重启、在空间中前进、开始一项任务、遵循程序、进入下一议题，或进入法庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: putting one foot in front of the other along a path.
core.cn: 核心意象：沿一条路一步步向前。

branches.en: RESUME: motion restarts after a pause, or an event is allowed to continue.
branches.cn: 重启：停顿后重新运动，或事件被允许继续。

branches.en: ADVANCE: physical forward movement becomes measurable progress.
branches.cn: 推进：物理的向前运动变成可测量的进展。

branches.en: NEXT STEP: the walk becomes a sequence of tasks or agenda items.
branches.cn: 下一步：行走变成任务或议程的序列。

branches.en: PROCEDURE: the path is scripted into repeatable steps.
branches.cn: 程序：路径被写成可重复的步骤。

branches.en: LAW AND SOURCE: proceed against starts legal machinery; the archaic sense comes forth from a source.
branches.cn: 法律与来源：proceed against 启动法律机器；古义指从源头出来。

intro.en: Proceed is a Latin verb. English adds -ing, -ure, and -al, and the root cedere also builds precede, succeed, exceed, and cede.
intro.cn: proceed 是拉丁动词。英语加 -ing、-ure、-al，词根 cedere 还构成 precede、succeed、exceed、cede。

latinIntro.en: Latin procedere 'go forward' sits beside cedere 'go, yield'. The family is directional: prae- gives precede, sub- gives succeed, pro- gives proceed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 procedere“向前走”旁边是 cedere“走、让”。这个词族是有方向的：prae- 生成 precede，sub- 生成 succeed，pro- 生成 proceed。

items.meaning: an action or piece of business; a legal step
records of a meeting; legal actions
an established way of doing something

latinEntries.meaning: to go forward, advance, come forth

definition_zh: 过程；程序；流程；工序；（法律）程序；（计算机）进程；加工处理
definition_en: a series of actions or changes that leads to a result, or to handle something through such a series
core_image: 一条流水线：原料从一端进入，经过一道道工序，从另一端出来成品
scene: 面包房里，面团要经过发酵、整形、烘烤。Fermenting, shaping and baking take four hours, and that process turns dough into something a shop can sell.
sceneCN: 这里 process 是「流程、工序」（第 1 个义项：为达到结果而进行的一系列动作）；句意：发酵、整形、烘烤要花四小时，这个流程把面团变成店里能卖的成品。图中可辨识物件：面团、发酵箱、整形台、烤炉、出炉的面包；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 过程；程序；流程；工序；（计算机）进程

senses.title: A series of actions toward a result
senses.definition: a set of actions taken in order to achieve a result
senses.definitionCN: 为达到结果而按序采取的一组动作
senses.example: The hiring process takes three weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 招聘流程需要三周。
senses.why: Latin processus is 'a going forward', from procedere. A process is a path with stages: it treats time as a route to be walked.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 processus 是“向前推进”，来自 procedere。process 是一条有阶段的路：它把时间当作要走完的路线。

senses.title: A natural series of changes
senses.definition: a course of natural changes that cannot be stopped
senses.definitionCN: 无法阻止的自然变化历程
senses.example: The process of decay begins at once.
senses.exampleCN: 腐烂过程立刻开始。
senses.why: Nature supplies the purest version: growth, erosion, decay. The word describes what happens by itself, without a planner.
senses.whyCN: 自然提供最纯粹的版本：生长、侵蚀、腐烂。这个词描述自行发生、没有规划者的事。

senses.title: A manufacturing procedure
senses.definition: the set of steps by which a product is made
senses.definitionCN: 制造产品所经的一组步骤
senses.example: The new process cuts production time in half.
senses.exampleCN: 新工序把生产时间缩短一半。
senses.why: Industry systematizes the path: each step has an input, an operation, and an output. Process becomes an engineered noun, and process engineering is born.
senses.whyCN: 工业把路径系统化：每一步都有输入、操作与输出。process 成了被工程化的名词，于是有了 process engineering。

senses.title: The legal course of proceedings
senses.definition: the formal steps required by law before a decision is valid
senses.definitionCN: 决定生效前法律要求的正式步骤
senses.example: The court must follow due process.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭必须遵循正当程序。
senses.why: Due process turns the path into a guarantee: the steps are not optional, and skipping one invalidates the result. Procedure and process converge here.
senses.whyCN: 正当程序把路径变成保障：步骤不可省略，跳过一步就使结果无效。procedure 与 process 在此汇合。

senses.title: A running program (computing)
senses.definition: an instance of a program running on a computer
senses.definitionCN: 计算机中正在运行的程序实例
senses.example: The process uses most of the memory.
senses.exampleCN: 这个进程占用了大部分内存。
senses.why: An operating system schedules tasks as a series of steps. Each running instance is a process, a path being walked by the machine.
senses.whyCN: 操作系统把任务安排成一系列步骤。每个运行实例就是一个 process，一条机器正在走的路径。

senses.title: To handle by a procedure
senses.definition: to deal with information or a request according to a set method
senses.definitionCN: 按既定方法处理信息或请求
senses.example: The computer processes thousands of forms a day.
senses.exampleCN: 计算机每天处理数千份表格。
senses.why: The verb turns the noun into action: to put something through the process. What is processed has entered the line and will come out changed.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词变成动作：把某物送进流程。被 processed 的东西已进入流水线，出来时会变样。

senses.title: To treat food or material
senses.definition: to change a raw material by physical or chemical treatment
senses.definitionCN: 通过物理或化学处理改变原料
senses.example: The factory processes milk into cheese.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂把牛奶加工成奶酪。
senses.why: Food processing is the clearest case: the input is real, the output is real, and the stages are visible. The word carries a neutral tone, though 'processed food' can sound negative.
senses.whyCN: 食品加工是最清楚的例子：输入真实，输出真实，阶段可见。这个词语气中性，尽管 processed food 听起来可能负面。

senses.title: To move in a procession (archaic)
senses.definition: in older usage, to walk in an ordered group
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：按队列行走
senses.example: The choir processed down the aisle.
senses.exampleCN: 唱诗班列队走过通道。
senses.why: This archaic verb keeps the literal Latin walk. The noun procession is its surviving relative, still used for ceremonial lines of people.
senses.whyCN: 这个古义动词保留拉丁语字面的“走”。名词 procession 是它存活的亲戚，仍指礼仪性的人列。

senses.title: A bony projection (anatomy)
senses.definition: a natural outgrowth or prominence on a bone or organ
senses.definitionCN: 骨或器官上的自然突出部分
senses.example: The mastoid process lies behind the ear.
senses.exampleCN: 乳突位于耳后。
senses.why: Anatomy names protrusions 'processes' because they 'go forward' from the body of the bone. The Latin motion word becomes a shape word.
senses.whyCN: 解剖学把突出部分称作 process，因为它们从骨体“向前伸出”。拉丁运动词变成了形状词。

intro.en: Process began as 'a going forward'. Latin processus comes from procedere, 'to advance', and English first used it for the course of events, then for industrial and legal sequences, and finally for running programs.
intro.cn: process 最初意为“向前推进”。拉丁语 processus 来自 procedere“前进”，英语先用它指事件进程，再指工业与法律序列，最后指运行中的程序。

items.en: First recorded as 'the fact of being carried on; a course of events'.
items.cn: 最早记录为“被推进的事实；事件的进程”。

items.en: From Latin processus 'a going forward, advance, progress', from procedere 'go forward'.
items.cn: 来自拉丁语 processus“前进、推进、进展”，源出 procedere“向前走”。

items.en: procedere = pro- 'forward' + cedere 'go'. The same verb gives proceed and procedure.
items.cn: procedere = pro-“向前”+ cedere“走”。同一动词生成 proceed 与 procedure。

items.en: The modern sense 'a continuous series of actions or changes' becomes established.
items.cn: 现代义“连续的动作或变化序列”确立。

items.en: Industrial use gives process engineering and manufacturing process.
items.cn: 工业用法产生 process engineering 与 manufacturing process。

items.en: Computing adopts the word for a running program, the newest link in the same chain.
items.cn: 计算机在 1960 年代采用这个词指运行程序，是同一链条上最新的一环。

note.en: The first group shares the cedere/procedere root; the second is about nouns that also mean a series of steps.
note.cn: 第一组共享 cedere/procedere 词根，第二组看同样表示“一系列步骤”的名词。

entries.definition: to go forward; the verb behind process.
entries.definitionCN: 向前走；process 背后的动词。

entries.definition: a prescribed set of steps. It stresses the rule, not the evolution.
entries.definitionCN: 规定的步骤。它强调规则，而非演化。

entries.definition: an ordered line of people moving. It keeps the literal walking sense.
entries.definitionCN: 有序行进的人列。它保留字面的行走义。

entries.definition: an official way of doing something. It is a process with authority behind it.
entries.definitionCN: 做某事的官方方式。它是有权威支撑的 process。

entries.definition: a planned way of doing something. It stresses design, not sequence in time.
entries.definitionCN: 有计划的做事方式。它强调设计，而非时间序列。

entries.definition: the way something develops over time. It is broader and less technical than process.
entries.definitionCN: 某物随时间发展的方式。它比 process 更宽、更少技术性。

normalIntro.en: Real links: Latin procedere 'go forward', the proceed/procedure/process family, due process, and the computing sense.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：拉丁语 procedere“向前走”、proceed/procedure/process 词族、正当程序，以及计算机义。

normal.en: Processus means 'a going forward'. A process is a path with stages, walked until something comes out.
normal.cn: processus 意为“向前推进”。process 是一条有阶段的路，走到某物出来为止。

normal.en: The verb behind it is proceed: pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'go'. Process is the noun of that walk.
normal.cn: 它背后的动词是 proceed：pro-“向前”加 cedere“走”。process 是那场行走的名词。

normal.en: Procedure is a process with rules attached: the same steps, now mandatory.
normal.cn: procedure 是附上规则的 process：同样的步骤，现在成了必须。

normal.en: Due process means the steps cannot be skipped; skipping one invalidates the result.
normal.cn: 正当程序意味着步骤不可跳过；跳过一步，结果就无效。

normal.en: In computing, a process is a program mid-walk: the machine is following its steps right now.
normal.cn: 计算机中，process 是走到一半的程序：机器正在执行它的步骤。

abstract.en: A process converts time into shape: what was merely passing becomes a route with stages.
abstract.cn: 过程把时间变成形状：原本只是流逝的东西，成了有阶段的路线。

abstract.en: Calling something a process can hide responsibility: nobody did it, it just went through its steps.
abstract.cn: 把某事称作 process 可以隐藏责任：没人做的，它只是走完了步骤。

abstract.en: Nature and factory share the word because both produce an output by ordered change.
abstract.cn: 自然与工厂共享这个词，因为两者都通过有序变化产出结果。

examples.en: Learning a language is a gradual process.
examples.cn: 学语言是一个渐进的过程。

examples.en: The application process is now fully online.
examples.cn: 申请流程现已完全在线。

examples.en: The plant processes raw cocoa into chocolate.
examples.cn: 工厂把生可可加工成巧克力。

dict_mnemonic.text: “扑若塞斯”——扑过去，像塞子一样一环环推进 → process 过程、流程

root: 拉丁语 processus“前进、推进”，源出 procedere“向前走”= pro-“向前”+ cedere“走”；同族有 proceed、procedure、procession。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of process, one path in different costumes. The path can be natural (decay), industrial (a production line), legal (due process), digital (a running program), or even anatomical (a bony projection).
sensesIntro.cn: process 的九个义项，是同一条路的不同装扮。这条路可以是自然的（腐烂）、工业的（生产线）、法律的（正当程序）、数字的（运行程序），甚至解剖的（骨突起）。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a route with stages, from input to output.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条有阶段的路，从输入到输出。

branches.en: COURSE: ordered change, whether planned or natural.
branches.cn: 历程：有序变化，无论有计划还是自然发生。

branches.en: MAKING: raw material enters a line and comes out changed.
branches.cn: 制造：原料进入流水线，出来时已变样。

branches.en: LAW: due process makes the steps mandatory and the result valid.
branches.cn: 法律：正当程序使步骤成为必须，使结果有效。

branches.en: COMPUTING: the path becomes a running program, and the verb means to put data through it.
branches.cn: 计算机：路径变成运行中的程序，动词意为让数据走一遍。

branches.en: SHAPE: the archaic walk survives in procession, while anatomy names protrusions 'processes'.
branches.cn: 形状：古义的行走存于 procession，解剖学则把突起称作 process。

intro.en: Process is noun and verb. English adds -ing, -or, and -ed, and the same Latin verb gives proceed, procedure, and procession.
intro.cn: process 既是名词也是动词。英语加 -ing、-or、-ed，同一拉丁动词还生成 proceed、procedure、procession。

latinIntro.en: Latin processus 'advance' comes from procedere 'go forward', built on cedere 'go'. The family is about ordered motion, from law courts to factory floors.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 processus“推进”来自 procedere“向前走”，建立在 cedere“走”上。这个词族关乎有序运动，从法庭到工厂车间。

items.meaning: the act of handling data or material
a device or person that processes
treated by an industrial or chemical process
able to be handled by a procedure
an ordered line of people moving
a prescribed way of doing something

definition_zh: 生产；制造；产生；出示；排演；农产品
definition_en: to make, grow or bring something into existence; as a noun, farm products
core_image: 果园枝头的果子被摘进篮子，篮子上贴着产地标签
scene: 农户把今年收的果子装筐，运到镇上的集市。The farm produces enough apples to fill a stall at the town market.
sceneCN: 农户把今年收的果子装筐运到镇上集市；句中的 produces 指「种出、出产某物」（第 2 个义项：以种植或养殖方式产出）。图中可辨识物件：果园、果筐、集市摊位、产地标签；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 生产；制造；产生；出示；排演
农产品（重音移到第一音节）

senses.title: Make or manufacture
senses.definition: to make something, especially in a factory or by a process
senses.definitionCN: 造出某物，尤指在工厂或经某一过程
senses.example: The plant produces parts for wind turbines.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂生产风力涡轮机的零件。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to lead forward, so making is bringing material forward into a finished thing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「向前引出」，因此制造就是把材料引成成品。

senses.title: Grow or yield from land
senses.definition: to grow crops or raise animals as a result of farming
senses.definitionCN: 通过耕作或养殖产出作物或畜禽
senses.example: The farm produces enough apples to fill a stall at the town market.
senses.exampleCN: 这个农场种的苹果足够装满镇上集市的一个摊位。
senses.why: A field yielding fruit is the same bringing-forth, with land rather than a machine doing the work.
senses.whyCN: 田地结出果实也是同一种「带出」，只是出力的是土地而非机器。

senses.title: Cause an effect
senses.definition: to cause something to happen or to exist
senses.definitionCN: 使某事发生或存在
senses.example: The new policy produced a sharp fall in complaints.
senses.exampleCN: 新政策使投诉量大幅下降。
senses.why: Once anything can be brought forth, the word covers results that are not physical objects.
senses.whyCN: 一旦任何东西都能被「带出」，这个词便涵盖并非实物的结果。

senses.title: Show or bring forward
senses.definition: to present something for inspection, such as a document or a ticket
senses.definitionCN: 把某物拿出来供查验，如文件或票据
senses.example: The witness produced the original receipt.
senses.exampleCN: 证人出示了原始收据。
senses.why: Bringing something before someone is a literal leading forward, which explains the legal use.
senses.whyCN: 把东西带到某人面前，字面上就是「向前引出」，这解释了法律用法。

senses.title: Stage a play or film
senses.definition: to prepare and present a play, film or show for an audience
senses.definitionCN: 筹备并向观众呈现戏剧、电影或节目
senses.example: The company will produce the play in the spring.
senses.exampleCN: 剧团将在春天排演这部戏。
senses.why: A show is brought out before an audience, so the cultural sense keeps the forward direction.
senses.whyCN: 一部戏被带到观众面前，因此文化义保留了「向前」的方向。

senses.title: Generate energy
senses.definition: to generate power, heat or another form of energy
senses.definitionCN: 发出电力、热量或其他形式的能量
senses.example: The dam produces power for three provinces.
senses.exampleCN: 这座大坝为三个省发电。
senses.why: Energy is led out of a source into a usable current, which fits the word's movement image.
senses.whyCN: 能量从源头被引出成可用的电流，正合这个词的「引出」意象。

senses.title: Farm products as a mass noun
senses.titleCN: 作不可数名词指农产品
senses.definition: fresh food grown on farms, sold as a group rather than counted one by one
senses.definitionCN: 农场种出的新鲜食物，作为整体出售而非逐件计数
senses.example: The shop buys its produce from nearby growers.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店从附近农户采购农产品。
senses.why: The verb's result became a collective noun for what the land brings forth.
senses.whyCN: 动词的结果转成了集合名词，指土地带出的东西。

senses.title: The fresh-food section of a shop
senses.definition: the fruit and vegetable section of a shop, or its stock
senses.definitionCN: 商店的果蔬区或其存货
senses.example: The produce aisle was restocked before opening.
senses.exampleCN: 开门前生鲜区补好了货。
senses.why: Retail narrows the collective noun to one department, the place where farm goods are sold.
senses.whyCN: 零售把集合名词收窄为一个部门，即卖农产品的地方。

intro.en: Produce comes from Latin producere 'to lead forward, bring out', through French. The noun for farm goods is a later English development of the same word.
intro.cn: produce 经法语来自拉丁 producere「向前引出、带出」；指农产品的名词义是同一词在英语中的后起发展。

items.en: Ducere meant 'to lead, draw'. It gives duct, conduct, reduce and educate.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导、拉」，衍生 duct、conduct、reduce 与 educate。

items.en: Pro- 'forward' plus ducere produced producere, 'to lead forward, bring out, bring forth'.
items.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere 构成 producere，意为「向前引出、带出」。

items.en: Old French produire carried the verb into English in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 古法语 produire 在十五世纪把这个动词带入英语。

items.en: By the sixteenth century produce could mean bring forward a document as well as bring goods into being.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，produce 既可指造出货物，也可指出示文件。

items.en: The mass noun for crops and fresh food appeared later, first in English rather than in Latin.
items.cn: 指作物与新鲜食物的不可数名词出现更晚，是英语自身的发展而非拉丁语原有。

items.en: Source uncertain: the first date of the farm noun is not firmly recorded, and the year is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定：农产品名词的最早年代没有确切记录，给出的年份只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds same-root words constantly confused with produce; group two holds near verbs for making and yielding.
note.cn: 第一组是同根且常与 produce 混淆的词；第二组是表示制造与产出的近义动词。

entries.definition: The thing made; produce as a verb makes products but never names them.
entries.definitionCN: 造出来的东西；作动词的 produce 制造产品，却不用它来指产品。

entries.definition: The activity or total output; it is what happens while produce is what is done.
entries.definitionCN: 活动或总产出；produce 是动作，production 是过程或总量。

entries.definition: The person or firm that makes; the verb names the act, not the actor.
entries.definitionCN: 制造的人或企业；动词指动作，不指施动者。

entries.definition: Re- 'again' plus produce: to make a copy or to breed; it repeats rather than originates.
entries.definitionCN: re-「再」加 produce：复制或繁殖；是重复而非原创。

entries.definition: The everyday verb for creating something; it is neutral in register where produce is formal.
entries.definitionCN: 创造某物的日常动词；语体中性，而 produce 较正式。

entries.definition: Making goods industrially; it rules out crops and effects, which produce allows.
entries.definitionCN: 工业制造货物；排除作物与结果，而 produce 都允许。

entries.definition: Producing power, data or ideas; it is close in sense three and six but rarer for goods.
entries.definitionCN: 产生电力、数据或想法；接近第 3、6 义，但少用于货物。

entries.definition: To give a crop or a result, often under pressure; it is the farming half of produce.
entries.definitionCN: 出产作物或结果，常含受压之意；是 produce 中务农的一半。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the lead-forward root, the mass noun and the fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：「向前引出」词根、不可数名词与固定搭配。

normal.en: Pro- 'forward' plus ducere 'lead': to produce is to lead something into being.
normal.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere「引导」：produce 就是把某物引出来。

normal.en: The family runs produce, product, production, producer, productive and reproduce.
normal.cn: 同族词有 produce、product、production、producer、productive 与 reproduce。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: produce evidence, produce results, farm produce, locally produced.
normal.cn: 固定说法：出示证据、产生结果、农产品、本地生产的。

normal.en: The noun shifts its stress to the first syllable, which is how English marks the change of word class.
normal.cn: 作名词时重音移到第一音节，这是英语标记词性变化的方式。

normal.en: The same root appears in conduct, introduce, reduce and educate.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educate 中。

abstract.en: Picture a tree handing fruit into a basket one branch at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵树一根枝一根枝地把果子交进篮子。

abstract.en: Picture a document sliding across a desk to be checked.
abstract.cn: 想象一份文件在桌面上滑过去接受查验。

abstract.en: Picture a switch that turns a river's weight into light in a room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个开关，把河流的重量变进房间的灯光。

examples.en: The region produces more olive oil than it can sell at home.
examples.cn: 该地区生产的橄榄油超过本地能卖出的量。

examples.en: The lawyer asked the company to produce the missing records.
examples.cn: 律师要求公司出示缺失的记录。

examples.en: A single change in the wording produced a very different response.
examples.cn: 措辞上的一处改动引出了很不一样的反应。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pro（向前）+ duce（引导）」——把东西一路引出来，就是生产与出产

root: 拉丁 producere「向前引出、带出」= pro-（向前）+ ducere「引导」；经古法语 produire 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one bringing-forth: manufacturing, farming, causing an effect, showing a document, staging a show, generating power, farm goods as a mass noun and finally the shop's fresh section.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕「带出」这个动作：制造、种出、引起结果、出示文件、排演、发电、作不可数名词指农产品，最后是商店的生鲜区。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a basket of picked fruit carrying a label that says where it grew.
core.cn: 核心意象：一篮摘下的果子，标签上写着它长在哪里。

branches.en: MAKING AND GROWING: a factory line and a field are both ways of leading material into a result.
branches.cn: 制造与种植：工厂流水线与田地，都是把材料引成结果的方式。

branches.en: BROUGHT FORTH: an effect and a document are both brought forward where they can be seen.
branches.cn: 被带出：结果与文件都被带到能被看见的地方。

branches.en: STAGE AND SHOP: a show and a fresh-food aisle are places where produce is presented to the public.
branches.cn: 舞台与店铺：演出与生鲜区，都是把出产呈现给公众的场所。

branches.en: POWER: energy is led out of a source into a current.
branches.cn: 电力：能量从源头被引出成电流。

branches.en: MASS NOUN: what the land brings forth becomes a collective name for food.
branches.cn: 集合名词：土地带出的东西成了食物的统称。

intro.en: Produce is a Latin verb of leading forward, and its prefix and root still build a large English family.
intro.cn: produce 是表示「向前引出」的拉丁动词，其前缀与词根仍构成一大片英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere gives conduct, introduce, reduce and educate; pro- adds the forward direction kept in produce.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ducere 衍生 conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educate；pro- 增添 produce 保留的向前方向。

items.example: The prefix points the action outward.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把动作指向外。

items.example: The product sells in six countries.

definition_zh: 生产者；制造商；制片人；（生态）生产者
definition_en: a person or company that makes goods, or the one who organizes a film or programme
core_image: 车间尽头的一双手给成品贴上标签，标签上写着出自谁手
scene: 剧组杀青那天，制片人站在监视器旁核对最后一份预算表。On the last day of shooting, the producer checked the final budget beside the monitor.
sceneCN: 剧组杀青那天，制片人站在监视器旁核对最后一份预算表；句中的 producer 指「负责组织并推进影视制作的人」（第 3 个义项：影视或戏剧的制片人）。图中可辨识物件：监视器、预算表、场记板、折叠椅；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 生产者；制造商；制片人；（生态）生产者

senses.title: A maker of goods
senses.definition: a person or firm that makes goods for sale
senses.definitionCN: 制造货物以供出售的人或企业
senses.example: The producer shipped the first batch on Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 制造商周一发出了第一批货。
senses.why: Producer is the doer form of produce, so it simply names whoever brings the goods forth.
senses.whyCN: producer 是 produce 的施动者形式，因此直接指把货物造出来的一方。

senses.title: The supplying side of an economy
senses.definition: the side of a market that makes and offers goods, as opposed to buyers
senses.definitionCN: 市场中制造并提供货物的一方，与买方相对
senses.example: Producers absorbed most of the higher input cost.
senses.exampleCN: 生产者承担了大部分上涨的投入成本。
senses.why: Economics splits a market into makers and takers, and producer names one whole side.
senses.whyCN: 经济学把市场分成制造方与取用方，producer 指其中一整侧。

senses.title: The organizer of a film or play
senses.definition: the person who arranges funding, staff and schedule for a film, play or series
senses.definitionCN: 为电影、戏剧或剧集安排资金、人员与进度的人
senses.example: On the last day of shooting, the producer checked the final budget beside the monitor.
senses.exampleCN: 杀青那天，制片人在监视器旁核对最后一份预算表。
senses.why: A show must be brought into existence like a product, so the one who arranges it takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 一部戏也要像产品一样被造出来，因此安排它的人沿用同一称呼。

senses.title: The organizer of a music recording
senses.definition: the person who supervises the recording, mixing and shape of a music release
senses.definitionCN: 监督录音、混音与成品形态的人
senses.example: The producer reshaped the album around a single riff.
senses.exampleCN: 制作人围绕一段乐句重塑了整张专辑。
senses.why: Music uses the same word because a record is assembled from parts under one hand.
senses.whyCN: 音乐沿用这个词，因为一张唱片是在一双手的安排下由各部分拼成的。

senses.title: A farmer or grower
senses.definition: a person or farm that grows crops or raises animals for sale
senses.definitionCN: 种植作物或饲养动物以供出售的人或农场
senses.example: Local producers sell directly at the Saturday market.
senses.exampleCN: 本地农业生产者周六直接在集市上出售。
senses.why: Growing food is one form of bringing forth, so farms count as producers in ordinary speech.
senses.whyCN: 种出食物是「带出」的一种，因此农场在日常语言里也算生产者。

senses.title: An organism that makes its own food
senses.titleCN: 生态学中自养的生产者
senses.definition: in ecology, an organism such as a plant that makes food from sunlight or chemicals
senses.definitionCN: 生态学中靠阳光或化学能自制食物的生物，如植物
senses.example: Green plants are the producers at the base of the food web.
senses.exampleCN: 绿色植物是食物网底层的生产者。
senses.why: Ecology borrowed the economic word for organisms that create food rather than consume it.
senses.whyCN: 生态学借用这个经济词，指制造食物而非消耗食物的生物。

senses.title: The organizer of a broadcast
senses.titleCN: 广播电视节目的制作负责人
senses.definition: the person responsible for putting a radio or television programme together
senses.definitionCN: 负责把广播或电视节目组织成形的人
senses.example: The producer cut the interview to fit the half-hour slot.
senses.exampleCN: 制片人把访谈剪到半小时内。
senses.why: A programme is assembled to a fixed length, and the one who assembles it is named as a maker.
senses.whyCN: 节目要按固定时长拼装，负责拼装的人便被称为制造者。

senses.title: Producer responsibility in policy
senses.titleCN: 环境政策中的生产者责任
senses.definition: the duty placed on manufacturers to take back or fund the disposal of their products
senses.definitionCN: 要求制造商回收或出资处理其产品的义务
senses.example: New rules extended producer responsibility to packaging.
senses.exampleCN: 新规把生产者责任扩展到包装。
senses.why: Policy makes the maker answerable for the whole life of the thing made.
senses.whyCN: 政策让制造者对成品的整个生命周期负责。

intro.en: Producer is the English agent noun of produce, formed with the suffix -er on a verb that comes from Latin producere 'to lead forward'. The film and music senses are nineteenth- and twentieth-century extensions.
intro.cn: producer 是 produce 的英语施动名词，在源自拉丁 producere「向前引出」的动词上加 -er 构成；影视与音乐义是十九、二十世纪的延伸。

items.en: Ducere meant 'to lead, draw'. Through producere it reaches produce, product and producer.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导、拉」，经 producere 通向 produce、product 与 producer。

items.en: Pro- 'forward' plus ducere gave producere, 'to lead forward, bring out'.
items.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere 构成 producere，意为「向前引出、带出」。

items.en: English took the verb through French; the agent suffix -er, from Old English -ere and French -eur, was added to name the doer.
items.cn: 英语经法语吸收这个动词，再加施动后缀 -er（源自古英语 -ere 与法语 -eur）来指做这件事的人。

items.en: From the sixteenth century a producer was simply one who brings something forth, whether crops or goods.
items.cn: 从十六世纪起，producer 只指带出某物的人，无论作物还是货物。

items.en: In the nineteenth century theatre and later film gave the word its managerial sense: the person who funds and organizes a show.
items.cn: 十九世纪的戏剧以及后来的电影赋予这个词管理义：出资并组织演出的人。

items.en: Source uncertain: the first use of the film sense is not precisely dated, and the year is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定：影视义的最早用例没有确切年代，给出的年份只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds same-root words that are often swapped; group two holds near roles that are not producers.
note.cn: 第一组是同根且常被互换的词；第二组是并非 producer 的近义角色。

entries.definition: The action itself, or farm goods as a noun; it is what a producer does, not the doer.
entries.definitionCN: 动作本身，或作名词指农产品；是 producer 所做的事，不是做的人。

entries.definition: What is made; a producer makes products, but product never names the maker.
entries.definitionCN: 被造出来的东西；生产者制造产品，但 product 从不指制造者。

entries.definition: The activity or total output; it names the making, while producer names the one making.
entries.definitionCN: 活动或总产出；指制造，而 producer 指制造者。

entries.definition: The person who shapes the performances and shots; the producer handles money and organization.
entries.definitionCN: 负责表演与镜头形态的人；制片人管钱与组织。

entries.definition: A firm that makes goods in factories; narrower and more industrial than producer.
entries.definitionCN: 在工厂制造货物的企业；比 producer 更窄、更工业。

entries.definition: The everyday word for one who makes something; it lacks the economic and media senses.
entries.definitionCN: 指制造者的日常词；不含经济与影视义。

entries.definition: A person who grows crops, especially fruit; it is the farming half of producer.
entries.definitionCN: 种植作物的人，尤指水果；是 producer 中务农的那一半。

entries.definition: A firm that provides goods to buyers; it stresses delivery rather than creation.
entries.definitionCN: 向买方提供货物的企业；侧重交付而非创造。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the agent suffix, the same-root family and the fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：施动后缀、同根词族与固定搭配。

normal.en: Produce plus -er: the one who brings the goods forth.
normal.cn: produce 加 -er：把货物带出来的那一方。

normal.en: The family runs produce, producer, production, product, productive and productivity.
normal.cn: 同族词有 produce、producer、production、product、productive 与 productivity。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: film producer, music producer, producer price, agricultural producer.
normal.cn: 固定说法：电影制片人、音乐制作人、出厂价、农业生产者。

normal.en: The same root appears in conduct, introduce, reduce and educate.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educate 中。

normal.en: Ecology keeps the word for plants that make their own food.
normal.cn: 生态学保留这个词，指能自制食物的植物。

abstract.en: Picture a hand stamping a finished box with a name.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在成品箱上盖下一个名字。

abstract.en: Picture a person holding the schedule and the budget at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人同时拿着进度表与预算表。

abstract.en: Picture a green leaf quietly making food for a whole food web.
abstract.cn: 想象一片绿叶默默为整张食物网制造食物。

examples.en: The producer delayed the release until the soundtrack was finished.
examples.cn: 制片人把发行推迟到配乐完成之后。

examples.en: Coffee producers in the highlands formed a cooperative.
examples.cn: 高地的咖啡生产者组建了合作社。

examples.en: New packaging rules make the producer pay for collection.
examples.cn: 新的包装规定让生产者承担回收费用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「produce（生产）+ r（人）」——把东西造出来的人，就是生产者与制片人

root: 英语 produce + 施动后缀 -er；produce 源自拉丁 producere「向前引出」= pro- + ducere「引导」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one maker: a firm, a whole supplying side, a film organizer, a music organizer, a farmer, a plant, a broadcast organizer and finally a policy duty.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一个制造者：企业、整个供给方、影视制片人、音乐制作人、农户、植物、节目制作负责人，最后是政策义务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand at the end of a line stamping a name on every finished item.
core.cn: 核心意象：流水线末端一只手在每件成品上盖下名字。

branches.en: MAKER AND ITS DUTIES: one firm, a whole market side, and the responsibility policy lays on them.
branches.cn: 制造者与其责任：一家企业、整个市场一侧，以及政策加在它们身上的责任。

branches.en: ORGANIZER: a film and a broadcast are both assembled by one person holding money and schedule.
branches.cn: 组织者：电影与广播节目，都由一个掌钱与掌进度的人拼装。

branches.en: RECORD: music borrows the same role for a release built from parts.
branches.cn: 唱片：音乐为一张拼装而成的作品借用同一角色。

branches.en: GROWER: a farm brings forth crops, which is production in the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 农户：农场带出作物，是最古老意义上的生产。

branches.en: AUTOTROPH: a plant makes its own food, so ecology calls it a producer.
branches.cn: 自养者：植物自制食物，生态学便称之为生产者。

intro.en: Producer is an English agent noun on a Latin verb of leading forward, so its ending and root can be read separately.
intro.cn: producer 是在「向前引出」的拉丁动词上加英语施动后缀构成，词尾与词根可分读。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere and producere supply the root; the -er ending came into English from both Old English and French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ducere 与 producere 提供词根；-er 词尾同时来自古英语与法语。

items.example: The prefix sends the making forward into a result.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把制造送向前，成为结果。

items.example: Farms produce most of the local food.
items.exampleCN: 农场生产大部分本地食物。

items.structure: agent suffix, Old English -ere and French -eur
items.example: The suffix turns the action into a person.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动作变成人。

items.example: The producer signed off the budget.
The product reached shops in June.

items.exampleCN: 两家公司指派了一位联合制片人。

definition_zh: 产品；产物；成果；（数学）乘积；（化学）生成物
definition_en: something produced by a process, a reaction, a multiplication or human work
core_image: 流水线尽头，一只刚成型的物件被机械臂放进托盘，旁边堆着已经空了的料箱
scene: 流水线尽头，一只刚成型的物件被机械臂放进托盘，旁边堆着已经空了的料箱。Water is the product of the reaction between hydrogen and oxygen.
sceneCN: 这里 product 指化学反应生成的产物（第 1 个义项：反应结束后新生成的物质）；句意：水是氢与氧反应的生成物。图中可辨识物件：传送带、机械臂、托盘、空料箱；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 产品；产物；成果；乘积；生成物

forms.label: 形容词（多产的；生产性的）

senses.title: What a chemical reaction makes
senses.titleCN: 化学反应生成的新物质
senses.definition: a substance formed when other substances react
senses.definitionCN: 由其他物质发生反应后生成的新物质
senses.example: Water is the product of the reaction between hydrogen and oxygen.
senses.exampleCN: 水是氢与氧反应的生成物。
senses.why: the word is the past participle of a Latin verb meaning to lead forth, so a product is literally what has been brought out of a process.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是拉丁动词「引出」的过去分词，因此 product 字面就是「被过程带出来的东西」。

senses.title: A thing made for sale
senses.definition: an item manufactured or grown in order to be sold
senses.definitionCN: 为出售而制造或种植的物品
senses.example: The company moved its best product to the front of the catalogue.
senses.exampleCN: 公司把最好的产品移到目录前页。
senses.why: commerce narrowed the general sense of what is brought forth to what is brought forth for a buyer.
senses.whyCN: 商业把「被带出来的东西」这一通义收窄为「为买家带出来的东西」。

senses.title: A result of effort
senses.definition: an outcome of work, thinking or events, often abstract
senses.definitionCN: 工作、思考或事件带来的结果，常为抽象之物
senses.example: The report was the product of three years of fieldwork.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告是三年野外工作的成果。
senses.why: if a process brings something out, anything brought out counts, including knowledge and institutions.
senses.whyCN: 只要过程能带出东西，被带出的一切都算，包括知识与制度。

senses.title: The result of multiplication
senses.definition: the number obtained by multiplying two or more numbers
senses.definitionCN: 两个或多个数相乘所得的数
senses.example: The product of six and seven is forty-two.
senses.exampleCN: 六与七的乘积是四十二。
senses.why: mathematics borrowed the same participle: multiplication brings forth a number from two others.
senses.whyCN: 数学借用了同一个分词：乘法从两个数里带出一个数。

senses.title: A child of its time or place
senses.definition: a person or thing shaped entirely by a particular background
senses.definitionCN: 完全由某一背景塑造的人或事物
senses.example: He was a product of the same crowded schools he later criticized.
senses.exampleCN: 他正是他后来批评的那种拥挤学校的产物。
senses.why: the metaphor says that circumstances manufacture people in the way a factory manufactures goods.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻说环境造人，正如工厂造货。

senses.title: Farm output
senses.definition: crops or other goods grown from the land, often in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 地里种出的作物等物产，常用复数
senses.example: The market sells local products from the surrounding farms.
senses.exampleCN: 这个市场出售周边农场的本地农产品。
senses.why: farming speaks of its output as produce, and the plural products marks things grown rather than made.
senses.whyCN: 农业把自己的产出说成 produce，复数 products 标记的是种出来的东西，而非造出来的。

senses.title: A work of media or art
senses.titleCN: 媒体或艺术作品的产物
senses.definition: a film, recording or other creative work considered as an item made by a studio
senses.definitionCN: 被视为由制片机构制作的电影、录音等创作成品
senses.example: The studio treats every film as a product with a release date.
senses.exampleCN: 制片方把每部电影都当作有发行日期的产品。
senses.why: the entertainment industry uses the commercial sense of the word, so a film becomes a product beside toys and tickets.
senses.whyCN: 娱乐业使用这个词的商业义，于是电影与玩具、门票并列成为产品。

senses.title: One item in a brand range
senses.titleCN: 品牌系列中的单个品项
senses.definition: a single item within a company's range, tracked separately in sales and marketing
senses.definitionCN: 公司系列中的单个品项，在销售与营销中单独核算
senses.example: Each product in the range has its own price and its own page.
senses.exampleCN: 系列中的每个产品都有自己的价格与页面。
senses.why: marketing splits a range into countable units, and the word becomes the unit of accounting rather than the whole output.
senses.whyCN: 营销把一个系列拆成可数的单位，这个词于是成为核算单位，而不是全部产出。

intro.en: Product comes from Latin productum, the neuter past participle of producere, to lead forth, built on pro-, forward, and ducere, to lead. It entered English in the sixteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: product 出自拉丁语 productum，即 producere「引出」的中性过去分词；该动词由 pro-「向前」与 ducere「引导」构成。它在 16 世纪进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead, draw or guide; its past participle ductum supplied a long series of English words. The deeper Indo-European root is a reconstruction.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导、拉、带领」，其过去分词 ductum 提供了一长串英语词。更早的印欧词根属于重构。

items.en: Pro-, forward, plus ducere produced producere, to lead forth, bring out, extend, which is the source of produce, product and production.
items.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere 构成 producere「引出、带出、延长」，是 produce、product 与 production 的来源。

items.en: The neuter participle productum came to be used as a noun for something brought out or brought forth, the direct model of the English word.
items.cn: 中性分词 productum 被当作名词使用，指被带出、被产生的东西，是英语词的直接样板。

items.en: Product entered English in the sixteenth century, first as a general word for a result and also as the mathematical term for the result of multiplication.
items.cn: product 于 16 世纪进入英语，最初泛指结果，同时也是表示乘法结果的数学术语。

items.en: From the nineteenth century the commercial sense of a manufactured item for sale became dominant, and the plural products spread into farming and marketing.
items.cn: 从 19 世纪起，指供出售的制成品这一商业义占据主导，复数形式 products 又扩散到农业与营销。

items.en: First date uncertain: the century of entry is well attested, but the earliest citation of the commercial sense is not settled, so the date given for that sense is approximate.
items.cn: 首见年代不确定：进入英语的世纪有可靠记载，但商业义的最早书证尚无定论，因此为该义给出的年代只是约数。

note.en: The first group shares the produce stem; the second group names other results and other stages of making something.
note.cn: 第一组共享 produce 词干；第二组是其他表示结果或制作阶段的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to bring forth; its noun form, pronounced differently, means fresh farm goods as a mass.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「产生、生产」的动词；其名词形式读音不同，指作为整体的新鲜农产品。

entries.definition: The activity or amount of making things; a product is the thing, production is the making of it.
entries.definitionCN: 指制作活动或产量；product 是物，production 是制作这件事。

entries.definition: Something made incidentally while the main product is being made; it is not the intended output.
entries.definitionCN: 在制造主要产品时顺带产生的东西，不是有意要的产出。

entries.definition: The person or firm that makes the product; the -er ending marks the maker rather than the made.
entries.definitionCN: 制作产品的人或公司；词尾 -er 标记制作者，而不是被制作之物。

entries.definition: The general word for what follows from something; it does not imply that the thing was made or sold.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指由某事带来的结果；不含「被制造或被出售」的意思。

entries.definition: What a system turns out, often measured as a rate or total; it stresses quantity more than the item itself.
entries.definitionCN: 系统产出的东西，常以速率或总量计量；强调数量多过单件物品。

entries.definition: The amount obtained from a process, especially a reaction or a field; chemistry counts yield, not products alone.
entries.definitionCN: 从过程得到的量，尤指反应或田地；化学算的是收率，而不只是产物本身。

entries.definition: Movable items for sale, always plural; it is a commercial collective, while product can name one item.
entries.definitionCN: 可供出售的动产，总用复数；它是商业集合名词，而 product 可以指单件。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin verb, the real word family and real commercial phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词、真实的同族词与真实的商业说法。

normal.en: Pro- forward plus ducere to lead: to lead something out of a process.
normal.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere「引导」：把某物从过程中引出来。

normal.en: The family runs produce, product, production, productive, productivity and producer.
normal.cn: 同族词有 produce、product、production、productive、productivity 与 producer。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the commercial sense: product line, product launch, final product.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出商业义：产品线、产品发布、成品。

normal.en: The same word serves the reaction and the multiplication, which is why chemistry and arithmetic share it.
normal.cn: 同一个词既服务反应也服务乘法，所以化学与算术共用它。

normal.en: Product and by-product differ by one prefix: the second is what came out although nobody planned it.
normal.cn: product 与 by-product 只差一个前缀：后者是没人计划却照样出来的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a conveyor belt that ends exactly where the empty crates begin.
abstract.cn: 想象一条传送带的终点，正好是空料箱开始的地方。

abstract.en: Picture a child who repeats the habits of a school he later argues against.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子，重复着他后来反对的那所学校的习惯。

abstract.en: Picture two numbers meeting and leaving one number behind.
abstract.cn: 想象两个数相遇，留下一个数。

examples.en: The reaction produces a gas as its main product.
examples.cn: 这个反应的主要产物是一种气体。

examples.en: A product that nobody can repair will not keep its buyers.
examples.cn: 无人能修的产品留不住买家。

examples.en: The product of the two lengths gives the area of the rectangle.
examples.cn: 两条边的乘积给出矩形的面积。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pro（向前）+ duct（引导）」——把东西往前带出来的结果 → 产品、产物

root: 拉丁 ducere「引导」→ pro- 加 ducere 成 producere「引出」→ 过去分词 productum → 英语 product「被带出的东西」；16 世纪进入英语，商业义确切首见年代无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one act: something is led out of a process. The act then serves a reaction, a factory, a piece of work, a multiplication, a whole era, a farm, a studio and finally one shelf item.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：某物被从过程中引出来。这个动作随后服务于反应、工厂、一项工作、一次乘法、一个时代、一片农田、一家制片机构，最后是货架上的一个单品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the end of a conveyor belt where a finished object drops into a tray beside empty crates.
core.cn: 核心意象：传送带的尽头，一件成品落进托盘，旁边是空了的料箱。

branches.en: THE REACTION OUTPUT: a new substance appears where two others met.
branches.cn: 反应产出：两种物质相遇之处出现一种新物质。

branches.en: THE SHELF: a made item, and then one countable item inside a range.
branches.cn: 货架：一件制成品，再细化为系列中可数的一个单品。

branches.en: WORK AND MEDIA: knowledge, reports and films are brought out like goods.
branches.cn: 劳动与媒体：知识、报告与影片也像货物一样被带出来。

branches.en: ARITHMETIC: multiplication brings one number out of two.
branches.cn: 算术：乘法从两个数里带出一个数。

branches.en: WHAT GROWS OR SHAPES: crops grown from land, and people shaped by their time.
branches.cn: 长成或被塑造之物：田里长出的作物，与被时代塑造的人。

intro.en: Product is a Latin participle turned noun, and its prefix and verb stem still build a large English family.
intro.cn: product 是拉丁分词转成的名词，其前缀与动词词干仍在构建一个庞大的英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin producere and productum supply the stem, and ducere supplies a whole series of English verbs through its participle ductum.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 producere 与 productum 提供词干，ducere 则通过其分词 ductum 提供了一整串英语动词。

items.example: The prefix adds the idea of bringing something out.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀加上「把某物带出来」的意思。

items.structure: ducere, duxi, ductum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.example: The verb supplies the idea of leading.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「引导」的意思。

items.example: The Latin verb is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁动词是整个词族的来源。

items.example: The participle became a noun in its own right.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词本身变成了名词。

items.example: Water is the product of the reaction.

items.structure: pro- plus ducere, as a verb
items.example: The factory produces parts for bicycles.
items.exampleCN: 这家工厂生产自行车零件。

items.example: Production rose after the line was rebuilt.
items.exampleCN: 生产线改建后产量上升。

items.example: The meeting was short and productive.
items.exampleCN: 这次会议简短而有成效。

items.example: Heat is a by-product of the reaction.
items.exampleCN: 热是这个反应的副产品。

items.example: The producer financed the whole shoot.
items.exampleCN: 制片人资助了整次拍摄。

definition_zh: 生产；产量；制作；（作品的）上演；生成
definition_en: the process of making goods, or the amount made
core_image: 一条流水线把原料一路推成成品，末端的成品箱不断堆高
scene: 工厂把旧线改成两班倒之后，一个月的成品数量翻了一倍。After the second shift was added, monthly production doubled.
sceneCN: 工厂把旧线改成两班倒，一个月的成品数量翻了一倍；句中的 production 指「把原料制成成品的过程及其产出」（第 1 个义项：制造商品的活动）。图中可辨识物件：流水线、成品箱、排班表、计数器；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 生产；产量；制作；上演；生成

senses.title: The making of goods
senses.definition: the activity of making goods from materials, especially in large amounts
senses.definitionCN: 用材料制造商品的活动，尤指大量制造
senses.example: After the second shift was added, monthly production doubled.
senses.exampleCN: 加上第二班之后，月产量翻了一倍。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to lead forward, so the word begins as bringing something out into being.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「向前引出」，因此这个词起于「把东西带出来、造出来」。

senses.title: The amount produced
senses.definition: the total quantity of something made in a given period
senses.definitionCN: 某段时期内造出的总量
senses.example: Rice production reached a ten-year high.
senses.exampleCN: 稻米产量达到十年来的最高点。
senses.why: The noun of the process slides into naming its result, so production can be a number.
senses.whyCN: 过程名词滑向指结果，因此 production 可以是一个数字。

senses.title: Economic output of goods and services
senses.titleCN: 经济意义上的商品与服务产出
senses.definition: the creation of goods and services measured as a whole economy's activity
senses.definitionCN: 作为整体经济活动衡量的商品与服务创造
senses.example: The region's production grew faster than its population.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区的产出增长快于人口增长。
senses.why: Economics treats the whole making activity as one quantity, which is this sense.
senses.whyCN: 经济学把全部制造活动当作一个量，这就是此义。

senses.title: Staging a play or film
senses.titleCN: 戏剧或影视的排演制作
senses.definition: the work of preparing and presenting a play, film or programme
senses.definitionCN: 筹备并呈现戏剧、电影或节目的工作
senses.example: Production on the film took fourteen months.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影的制作花了十四个月。
senses.why: A play is brought out before an audience, which is the same leading-forward image in culture.
senses.whyCN: 戏剧被带到观众面前，与文化领域的「引出」意象相同。

senses.title: Bringing forth knowledge or results
senses.definition: the act of generating ideas, evidence or results rather than goods
senses.definitionCN: 产生想法、证据或成果而非货物的行为
senses.example: The lab's production of reliable data made the review possible.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室产出可靠数据，才使这次评审成为可能。
senses.why: Anything brought into existence can be produced, so the word extends from factories to research.
senses.whyCN: 任何被带进存在的东西都可被「生产」，因此这个词从工厂延伸到研究。

senses.title: A bodily substance generated
senses.definition: the generation of a substance by a living body, such as a hormone
senses.definitionCN: 活体生成某种物质，如激素
senses.example: Stress increases the production of cortisol.
senses.exampleCN: 压力会增加皮质醇的生成。
senses.why: Biology keeps the core meaning of bringing something forth, with no factory involved.
senses.whyCN: 生物学保留「带出某物」的核心义，却不涉及工厂。

senses.title: The stage of being made
senses.definition: the stage at which something is being manufactured or filmed
senses.definitionCN: 某物正在被制造或拍摄的阶段
senses.example: The new model is in production but not yet on sale.
senses.exampleCN: 新车型已在生产，但尚未开售。
senses.why: The phrase in production names a phase of the process, which is why it takes a fixed preposition.
senses.whyCN: in production 指过程的一个阶段，因此配固定介词。

senses.title: A particular staged work
senses.definition: a single play, film or show as staged by a company
senses.definitionCN: 某团体排演的一部戏、电影或节目
senses.example: The festival opened with a new production of the opera.
senses.exampleCN: 艺术节以这部歌剧的新制作开幕。
senses.why: The process noun finally stands for one finished work, a countable product of the stage.
senses.whyCN: 过程名词最终指一部成品，成为舞台上可数的产物。

intro.en: Production comes from Latin productio, 'a bringing forth', from producere 'to lead forward', built on pro- 'forward' and ducere 'to lead'. English took it through French in the fifteenth century.
intro.cn: production 来自拉丁 productio「带出、引出」，源自动词 producere「向前引出」，由 pro-「向前」与 ducere「引导」构成，十五世纪经法语进入英语。

items.en: Ducere meant 'to lead, draw'. It gives duct, conduct, introduce, reduce and educate.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导、拉」，衍生 duct、conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educate。

items.en: Pro- 'forward' plus ducere produced producere, 'to lead or bring forward, to bring out'.
items.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere 构成 producere，意为「向前引出、带出」。

items.en: Productio named a bringing forth or a stretching out; the sense of making goods grew later.
items.cn: productio 指「带出、拉长」；制造货物的意思出现较晚。

items.en: English adopted production through French, at first for bringing something into existence rather than for factories.
items.cn: 英语经法语吸收 production，最初指使某物产生，而非工厂制造。

items.en: Eighteenth- and nineteenth-century industry fixed the modern sense: the making of goods in quantity, measured as output.
items.cn: 十八、十九世纪的工业固定了现代义：大量制造货物，并以产出计量。

items.en: Source uncertain: whether the noun came directly from Latin or through French is not settled, and the earliest date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定：这个名词是直接来自拉丁语还是经法语传入，尚无定论；最早年代也是约数。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same lead-forward root that are easily confused; group two holds near words for making and output.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「向前引出」词根、易混的词；第二组是表示制造与产出的近义词。

entries.definition: Same root: the thing that results, while production is the activity or the total amount.
entries.definitionCN: 同根：指产生的那件东西，而 production 指活动或总量。

entries.definition: The verb of making, and as a noun farm goods; it is the action behind production.
entries.definitionCN: 表示制造的动词，作名词时指农产品；是 production 背后的动作。

entries.definition: The one who makes, or the one who organizes a film; it names an agent, not a process.
entries.definitionCN: 制造者或组织影片的人；指施动者而非过程。

entries.definition: Re- 'again' plus production: the making of a copy, or the biological bearing of young.
entries.definitionCN: re-「再」加 production：复制，或生物的繁殖。

entries.definition: What comes out of a process, especially as a measured quantity; it matches sense two closely.
entries.definitionCN: 一个过程的产物，尤指可计量的数量；与第 2 义接近。

entries.definition: Making goods on an industrial scale; it stresses factories and hands, where production is broader.
entries.definitionCN: 工业规模地制造货物；强调工厂与手工，而 production 范围更广。

entries.definition: The producing of something, especially energy or offspring; it is closer to the older sense than to factory output.
entries.definitionCN: 产生某物，尤指能源或后代；比工厂产出更接近较早的词义。

entries.definition: Bringing something into existence, often artistic or original; production may only repeat an existing design.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物产生，常指艺术或原创；production 可能只是重复既有设计。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the lead-forward root, the fixed phrases and the industrial sense.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：「向前引出」词根、固定搭配与工业义。

normal.en: Pro- 'forward' plus ducere 'lead': production leads material forward into a product.
normal.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere「引导」：生产把材料一路引成产品。

normal.en: The family runs produce, producer, product, productive, productivity and reproduction.
normal.cn: 同族词有 produce、producer、product、productive、productivity 与 reproduction。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: production line, mass production, production costs, in production.
normal.cn: 固定说法：生产线、批量生产、生产成本、在生产中。

normal.en: The same root appears in conduct, introduce, reduce and educate.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educate 中。

normal.en: Economics pairs it with consumption: what is made and what is used up.
normal.cn: 经济学把它与消费配对：造出来的与用掉的。

abstract.en: Picture raw bales entering one end of a line and boxes leaving the other.
abstract.cn: 想象原料包从流水线一端进去，成品箱从另一端出来。

abstract.en: Picture a counter that clicks once per finished item all day.
abstract.cn: 想象一只计数器，每出一件成品就跳一下，整天不停。

abstract.en: Picture a stage where a script slowly becomes a lit set.
abstract.cn: 想象一方舞台，剧本慢慢变成亮起的布景。

examples.en: The factory raised production without adding a single worker.
examples.cn: 工厂没有增加一名工人就提高了产量。

examples.en: Steel production fell during the third quarter.
examples.cn: 第三季度钢铁产量下降。

examples.en: The new production of the play moved the action to a modern city.
examples.cn: 这部戏的新制作把故事搬到了现代城市。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pro（向前）+ duct（引导）+ ion」——把原料一路引出来，就是生产

root: 拉丁 productio「带出、引出」，来自 producere = pro-（向前）+ ducere「引导」；经法语进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one bringing-forth: making goods, the amount made, the whole economy's output, a staged work, new knowledge, a bodily substance, the stage of being made and finally one finished production.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕「带出」这个动作：制造货物、产量、整体经济产出、舞台制作、新知识、体内物质、正在制造的阶段，最后是一部成品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line that carries raw material forward until it emerges as a finished box.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条把原料一路送到出口、变成成品箱的线。

branches.en: ACT AND SCALE: one factory's making and a whole economy's making are the same act at different sizes.
branches.cn: 动作与规模：一家工厂的制造与整个经济的制造，是同一动作的不同尺度。

branches.en: AMOUNT AND PHASE: the figure produced and the stage of being produced are two views of one process.
branches.cn: 数量与阶段：造出的数字与正在造的阶段，是同一过程的两种视角。

branches.en: STAGE: preparing a show and one finished staging are the process and its countable result.
branches.cn: 舞台：排演与一部成品，是过程与可数的结果。

branches.en: KNOWLEDGE: data and ideas are brought forth exactly as goods are.
branches.cn: 知识：数据和想法被带出来，与货物一样。

branches.en: BODY: a gland making a hormone is production with no factory at all.
branches.cn: 身体：腺体生成激素，是完全没有工厂的生产。

intro.en: Production is a Latin noun of leading forward, built from a prefix, a lead-root and an action ending.
intro.cn: production 是由「向前引出」构成的拉丁名词，包含前缀、引导词根与动作词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere gives conduct, introduce, reduce and educate; pro- adds the forward direction that production keeps.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ducere 衍生 conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educate；pro- 增添 production 保留的向前方向。

items.example: The prefix sends the action outward.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把动作送向外。

items.example: The root carries the pulling forward.
The verb produced the English produce.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词给出了英语的 produce。

items.example: The region produces most of the crop.
items.exampleCN: 该地区生产大部分这种作物。

items.example: The product sold out in a week.

items.exampleCN: 那是一个颇有成效的下午。

items.example: Productivity rose with the new tools.
items.exampleCN: 有了新工具，生产率提高了。
博物馆订了一件复制品。

definition_zh: 职业；行业；同业；声明；信仰表白
definition_en: a job that needs special training and a formal qualification, the people who do it, or an open declaration of belief
core_image: 一个人站在众人面前，一手按在胸前，公开说出自己以什么为业、又信什么
scene: 面试官问她靠什么谋生，她说自己受过多年训练，做的是需要执照的活儿。She practises the legal profession in a small coastal town.
sceneCN: 这里表示「需要专门训练的职业」（第 1 个义项：以长期训练和正式资格为基础的谋生行当）；句意为她在一座海滨小城从事法律工作。

derivatives.zh: 由 profession 加 -al 构成，义为「职业的；专业人士」
由 professional 加 -ism 构成，义为「专业水准；职业精神」
与 profession 同出拉丁语 profiteri，义为「公开宣称；声称」

senses.title: A job that requires special training and qualifications
senses.definition: a type of work that needs long training and a formal qualification, such as law or medicine
senses.definitionCN: 需要长期训练与正式资格的工作，如法律或医学
senses.example: She chose teaching as her profession.
senses.exampleCN: 她选择教书作为自己的职业。
senses.why: The Latin source meant to declare openly; a profession is the work one publicly declares as one's own, not a task done quietly and unnamed.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语源头意为「公开宣称」；职业就是一个人当众声明属于自己的那份工作，而不是默默无名地做的杂活。

senses.title: The whole group of people who do such work
senses.definition: all the people who work in one such field, considered as a body with shared standards
senses.definitionCN: 在某一此类领域工作的所有人，被视为拥有共同标准的一个整体
senses.example: The medical profession opposed the new rules.
senses.exampleCN: 医学界反对这些新规定。
senses.why: If a profession is what each member declares, the same word can name the company of all who make that declaration.
senses.whyCN: 既然职业是每个成员公开认领的东西，同一个词也就能指所有做出这一认领的人所组成的群体。

senses.title: A solemn declaration of religious faith
senses.definition: a formal and public statement that one holds a particular religious belief
senses.definitionCN: 公开而正式地表明自己持守某一宗教信仰
senses.example: Her profession of faith was made before the whole congregation.
senses.exampleCN: 她在全体会众面前作了信仰表白。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: the Latin verb meant to declare aloud, and the first things declared in that way were matters of belief.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：拉丁动词本义就是「大声声明」，而最早被这样声明的正是信仰上的事。

senses.title: An open claim about one's feelings or intentions
senses.definition: a statement in which someone openly claims to feel or intend something
senses.definitionCN: 某人公开声称自己有某种感受或打算的说法
senses.example: His profession of friendship did not convince anyone.
senses.exampleCN: 他声称的友谊没能说服任何人。
senses.why: Once the word means a public declaration, it can carry any claim a person makes aloud, including one that others may doubt.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个词表示「公开声明」，它就能承载任何被人大声说出的主张，包括旁人未必相信的那种。

intro.en: Profession and professor grow from the same Latin verb, but one names the declared work and the other the person who declares it.
intro.cn: profession 与 professor 出自同一个拉丁动词，但前者指被公开认领的工作，后者指做这种公开宣称的人。

items.en: Fateri meant to confess or acknowledge, to say something about oneself that others could hear.
items.cn: fateri 意为承认、供认，是把自己身上的事说给别人听。

items.en: Pro- made it public: profiteri meant to declare openly, often a belief or a calling.
items.cn: 前缀 pro- 使它变为公开：profiteri 意为公开声明，常指声明信仰或志业。

items.en: The noun professio was a public declaration, and in Roman law it could also be the declared occupation on which tax was paid.
items.cn: 名词 professio 指公开声明；在罗马法中也可指申报并据此纳税的职业。

items.en: Old French profession kept both the religious and the occupational senses and passed them to English.
items.cn: 古法语 profession 同时保留宗教与职业两种含义，并把它们传入英语。

items.en: English uses profession mainly for qualified work and its body, while the older sense of open declaration survives in phrases such as a profession of faith.
items.cn: 现代英语主要用 profession 指需要资格的工作及其群体，而「公开声明」的旧义仍保存在 a profession of faith 这类说法里。

note.en: The first group shows the same Latin verb and its family, including the word for the person who declares; the second gathers words for jobs and for formal statements.
note.cn: 第一组收同一拉丁动词及其词族，包括指「宣称者」的词；第二组收表示工作与正式陈述的词。

entries.definition: To state openly that one has a belief or feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 公开表明自己持有某种信仰或感受。

entries.definition: A senior university teacher; literally one who declares publicly.
entries.definitionCN: 资深大学教师；字面义为公开宣称的人。

entries.definition: Relating to a profession, or a person who works in one.
entries.definitionCN: 与职业有关的；从事某一职业的人。

entries.definition: To admit something one would rather keep hidden.
entries.definitionCN: 承认本不愿让人知道的事；坦白。

entries.definition: The job by which a person earns money.
entries.definitionCN: 一个人谋生所从事的工作。

entries.definition: The whole course of a person's working life.
entries.definitionCN: 一个人整个职业生涯的历程。

entries.definition: A skilled job, especially one done with the hands.
entries.definitionCN: 需要手艺的工作，尤指手工行业。

entries.definition: A formal statement made in public.
entries.definitionCN: 在公开场合做出的正式陈述。

normalIntro.en: One Latin verb of public declaration runs through the whole family, which is why the same word can mean a job and a statement of belief.
normalIntro.cn: 一整族词都建立在同一个表示「公开声明」的拉丁动词上，所以同一个词既能指职业，也能指信仰声明。

normal.en: Fateri is to admit; pro- makes it public, so profiteri is to say openly who you are and what you do.
normal.cn: fateri 是承认，pro- 使之公开，所以 profiteri 就是当众说出自己是谁、做什么。

normal.en: A profession is the work you declare as yours; a professor is the person who declares and teaches.
normal.cn: profession 是你公开认领的工作；professor 是做公开声明并讲授的人。

normal.en: The medical profession means the doctors as a group, because the declared work gathers its members into one body.
normal.cn: the medical profession 指医生这个群体，因为被共同认领的工作把成员聚成了一个整体。

normal.en: A profession of faith keeps the old sense of a spoken declaration, not a job.
normal.cn: a profession of faith 保留的是「口头声明」的旧义，与工作无关。

normal.en: Professional adds -al to profession, turning the field into an adjective or into the person who belongs to it.
normal.cn: professional 在 profession 后加 -al，把这个领域变成形容词，或指属于该领域的人。

abstract.en: A job becomes a profession only when it is publicly named, which suggests that recognition is part of the work itself.
abstract.cn: 一份工作只有被公开命名才成为职业，这说明「被承认」本身就是这份工作的一部分。

abstract.en: The same word covers what you do and what you believe, because both are things you stand up and declare.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既覆盖你做什么，也覆盖你信什么，因为两者都是你站出来声明的东西。

abstract.en: A profession is a promise made in public: that is why its members are held to shared standards.
abstract.cn: 职业是一份当众做出的承诺，所以它的成员要受共同标准的约束。

examples.en: She entered the teaching profession at twenty-two.
examples.cn: 她二十二岁进入教师行业。

examples.en: His profession of loyalty sounded sincere.
examples.cn: 他声称的忠诚听起来很真诚。

examples.en: Members of the legal profession attended the hearing.
examples.cn: 法律界人士出席了听证会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普若费神」——挑职业要费神，入错行更费神；记住 profession 是职业。

root: 拉丁语 pro-（向前、公开）+ fateri（承认、供认）→ profiteri（公开声明）→ professio（声明、申报的职业），经古法语 profession 进入英语；与 professor 同源。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is a public declaration; from it come the declared job, the body of people who share that job, and the statement of belief or feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是「公开声明」；由此分出被公开认领的职业、共享该职业的群体，以及信仰或情感的表白。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person standing before a crowd, naming aloud the work he does and the belief he holds.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在众人面前，大声说出自己所做的工作与所持的信念。

branches.en: a person naming a calling and a loyalty in the same breath
branches.cn: 同一次开口里既说出志业，也说出忠诚

branches.en: doctors closing ranks behind their common standards
branches.cn: 医生们以共同标准站成一体

branches.en: a congregation listening to a spoken creed
branches.cn: 会众聆听一段口头的信条

branches.en: a young woman choosing law after years of study
branches.cn: 年轻女子在多年学习后选择法律

branches.en: a claim of friendship that others quietly doubt
branches.cn: 旁人暗自怀疑的友谊表白

intro.en: A Latin verb of admitting, its public prefix, and the noun and adjective endings built on them hold the word together.
intro.cn: 表示「承认」的拉丁动词、表示公开的前缀，以及建立其上的名词与形容词词尾，共同支撑这个词。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录。

definition_zh: 职业的；专业的；专职的；专业人员；行家；（体育）职业选手
definition_en: relating to a paid occupation, or showing the skill and standards expected in one
core_image: 一件熨得笔挺的白大褂，胸口别着写有姓名的工牌
scene: 手术室里，主刀医生动作稳而快。Every step was measured and every cut was clean, and the assistant called that level of care professional.
sceneCN: 这里 professional 是「专业的、达到职业水准的」（第 3 个义项：具备职业所需的技能与规范）；句意：每一步都经过斟酌，每一刀都干净利落，助手把这种水准称为专业。图中可辨识物件：手术台、无影灯、器械盘、白大褂、工牌；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 职业的；专业的；专职的；合乎职业规范的
专业人员；行家；（体育）职业选手

forms.label: 比较级（更多用 more 构成）
最高级（更多用 most 构成）

derivatives.zh: 不专业的；违反职业规范的

senses.title: Relating to a profession
senses.definition: connected with a profession or its members
senses.definitionCN: 与某个职业或其成员相关
senses.example: professional bodies set entry exams.
senses.exampleCN: 行业机构设置入行考试。
senses.why: Profession comes from Latin professio, 'a public declaration'. A professional was first someone who had publicly declared a calling, which is why the word implies a recognized field.
senses.whyCN: profession 来自拉丁语 professio“公开宣告”。professional 最初指公开宣告某种志业的人，所以这个词隐含一个被承认的领域。

senses.title: Done as a paid occupation
senses.definition: engaged in for payment rather than as a hobby
senses.definitionCN: 为报酬而从事，而非作为爱好
senses.example: She is a professional musician.
senses.exampleCN: 她是一名职业音乐家。
senses.why: The 18c. sharpened the contrast with amateur: a professional is paid, an amateur is not. Money becomes the marker that separates the two.
senses.whyCN: 18 世纪强化了与 amateur 的对比：professional 拿钱，业余者不拿。金钱成了区分两者的标记。

senses.title: Competent and skillful
senses.definition: showing the skill and care expected of a trained person
senses.definitionCN: 表现出受训者应有的技能与用心
senses.example: That was a very professional repair job.
senses.exampleCN: 那次维修做得非常专业。
senses.why: Skill turns the label into a compliment: work is professional when it meets the standard a paying client would expect. The word moves from status to quality.
senses.whyCN: 技能把这个标签变成赞美：当工作达到付费客户期待的标准，它就是专业的。这个词从身份转向品质。

senses.title: A member of a profession
senses.definition: a person who works in a profession, especially a learned one
senses.definitionCN: 从事某一职业的人，尤指需要专门学识者
senses.example: The panel included doctors and other professionals.
senses.exampleCN: 专家组包括医生及其他专业人员。
senses.why: The noun names the person behind the adjective. In modern English it often covers lawyers, doctors, engineers, and accountants — fields with entry rules and codes.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词命名形容词背后的人。现代英语中它常涵盖律师、医生、工程师、会计师——有准入规则与职业准则的领域。

senses.title: An expert in a field
senses.definition: a person with high skill in some activity
senses.definitionCN: 在某项活动中技能很高的人
senses.example: He is a professional when it comes to chess.
senses.exampleCN: 在国际象棋上他是个行家。
senses.why: The word can leave the salaried professions behind and simply mean 'someone who really knows'. This looser use turns expertise itself into the qualification.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以离开领薪的职业，只表示“真正懂行的人”。这种宽松用法把专长本身当成资格。

senses.title: A paid sports player
senses.definition: in sport, a player who is paid to compete
senses.definitionCN: 体育中受薪参赛的选手
senses.example: He turned professional at nineteen.
senses.exampleCN: 他十九岁转为职业选手。
senses.why: Sport copied the paid/amateur divide. Turning professional means crossing a line: from playing for love to playing for a living, with different rules and stakes.
senses.whyCN: 体育复制了“受薪／业余”的分界。转为职业，意味着跨过一条线：从为热爱而赛，到为生计而赛，规则与利害都不同。

senses.title: Conforming to professional standards
senses.definition: behaving with the ethics and manners of a profession
senses.definitionCN: 以某职业的伦理与礼节行事
senses.example: Her response was calm and professional.
senses.exampleCN: 她的回应冷静而专业。
senses.why: Conduct is judged, not skill. The word can praise someone who keeps confidences and meets deadlines, even when the task is routine.
senses.whyCN: 这里被评判的是行为，不是技能。即使任务平常，这个词也能赞美守密、守时的人。

senses.title: Of high quality, informally
senses.definition: in informal use, well-made or impressive
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用法：做得好的、像样的
senses.example: They did a professional job on the garden.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把花园弄得相当像样。
senses.why: The compliment has spread beyond occupations: anything done with care can look professional. The word now sells quality as much as status.
senses.whyCN: 这种赞美已超出职业范围：任何用心做成的事都可能显得 professional。这个词现在既卖身份，也卖品质。

senses.title: A euphemism for a sex worker (archaic)
senses.definition: in older usage, a euphemism for a prostitute
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：对妓女的委婉说法
senses.example: The old novel refers to her as a professional.
senses.exampleCN: 那部旧小说用 professional 指称她。
senses.why: The 'paid occupation' sense sits close to a taboo, so the euphemism was available. Modern usage avoids it because the main sense has become too respectable to carry the hint.
senses.whyCN: “受薪职业”义接近禁忌，因此这个委婉说法曾可用。现代用法避开它，因为主要义已太体面，承载不了这层暗示。

intro.en: Professional is built on profession, and profession began as a public declaration. Latin profiteri means 'declare openly', from pro- 'forth' plus fateri 'to confess'. A professional is, etymologically, someone who has declared what they do.
intro.cn: professional 建立在 profession 上，而 profession 始于“公开宣告”。拉丁语 profiteri 意为“公开宣称”，由 pro-“向前、出来”加 fateri“承认”构成。从词源看，professional 就是公开宣告自己以何为业的人。

items.en: First recorded as an adjective meaning 'of or belonging to a profession'.
items.cn: 最早记录为形容词，义为“属于某一职业的”。

items.en: profession (late 14c.) comes from Latin professionem, 'a public declaration', from profiteri 'declare openly'.
items.cn: profession（14 世纪末）来自拉丁语 professionem“公开宣告”，源出 profiteri“公开宣称”。

items.en: profiteri = pro- 'forth, publicly' + fateri 'to confess, admit'. The root fateri also gives confession and fate in related senses.
items.cn: profiteri = pro-“向外、公开”+ fateri“承认、告白”。词根 fateri 还生成 confession 等相关词。

items.en: The sense 'engaged in a profession as a paid calling' is recorded.
items.cn: “以某职业为受薪志业”的义项被记录。

items.en: The noun professional appears for a person who makes a living by a profession.
items.cn: 名词 professional 出现，指以某职业谋生的人。

items.en: Modern English extends the adjective from occupations to quality and conduct: professional advice, professional standards, a professional job.
items.cn: 现代英语把形容词从职业扩展到品质与行为：professional advice、professional standards、a professional job。

note.en: The first group shares the profession/profiteri stem; the second is about words that also mean skilled or paid.
note.cn: 第一组共享 profession/profiteri 词干，第二组看同样表示“有技能”或“受薪”的词。

entries.definition: a paid occupation requiring training. It is the noun behind professional.
entries.definitionCN: 需要训练的受薪职业。它是 professional 背后的名词。

entries.definition: the standards and conduct of a profession.
entries.definitionCN: 职业标准与职业精神。

entries.definition: a university teacher, literally one who professes a subject.
entries.definitionCN: 大学教授，字面“宣称某学科者”。

entries.definition: a person with special knowledge. It stresses knowledge, not pay or code.
entries.definitionCN: 有专门知识的人。它强调知识，而非报酬或准则。

entries.definition: having trained ability. It says nothing about a profession or payment.
entries.definitionCN: 受过训练、有能力。它不涉及职业或报酬。

entries.definition: relating to a job. It is neutral and technical, unlike the status-laden professional.
entries.definitionCN: 与工作相关的。它中性、技术性，不像 professional 带身份色彩。

normalIntro.en: Real links: Latin profiteri 'declare openly', the paid/amateur divide, the professional/professor family, and the modern quality sense.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：拉丁语 profiteri“公开宣称”、受薪／业余之分、professional/professor 词族，以及现代品质义。

normal.en: Latin profiteri means 'declare openly': a professional has publicly declared what they do.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 profiteri 意为“公开宣称”：professional 已公开宣告自己以何为业。

normal.en: The 18c. made money the test: professionals are paid, amateurs are not.
normal.cn: 18 世纪以金钱为标准：professional 受薪，业余者不受薪。

normal.en: Professor and professional share the root: both publicly profess a field.
normal.cn: professor 与 professional 共享词根：两者都公开宣称某个领域。

normal.en: The word has moved from status to quality: a professional job is simply a job done to a high standard.
normal.cn: 这个词从身份滑向品质：a professional job 就是做得高标准的工作。

normal.en: In sport, turning professional means crossing from playing for love to playing for a living.
normal.cn: 体育中，转为职业意味着从为热爱而赛，跨到为生计而赛。

abstract.en: A profession is a public promise: the declaration is what binds the practitioner to a code.
abstract.cn: 职业是一份公开承诺：宣告把从业者绑定到一套准则上。

abstract.en: Professionalism is a form of trust infrastructure: strangers can rely on you because a field vouches for you.
abstract.cn: 专业精神是一种信任基础设施：陌生人能依赖你，因为一个领域为你背书。

abstract.en: When the word praises quality rather than occupation, it shows how deeply work and identity are fused in modern life.
abstract.cn: 当这个词赞美品质而非职业时，它显示出工作与身份在现代生活中融合得有多深。

examples.en: You should seek professional advice before investing.
examples.cn: 投资前你应当寻求专业建议。

examples.en: She handled the complaint in a professional manner.
examples.cn: 她以专业的方式处理了这起投诉。

examples.en: He became a professional football player at twenty.
examples.cn: 他二十岁时成为职业足球运动员。

dict_mnemonic.text: “扑若费神”——为了职业扑上去费神打磨 → professional 职业的、专业的

root: 由 profession + -al 构成；profession 来自拉丁语 professio“公开宣告”，源出 profiteri“公开宣称”= pro-“向外”+ fateri“承认”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of professional, all built on a public declaration. The declaration can name an occupation, mark payment, certify skill, impose conduct, or simply advertise quality.
sensesIntro.cn: professional 的九个义项都建立在一次公开宣告上。这次宣告可以命名职业、标记受薪、证明技能、施加行为准则，或仅仅为品质作广告。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a public declaration that binds a person to a standard.
core.cn: 核心意象：一次公开宣告，把人绑定到某个标准上。

branches.en: FIELD: a recognized occupation and the people who belong to it.
branches.cn: 领域：被承认的职业及其成员。

branches.en: PAY: the paid/amateur line, in work and in sport.
branches.cn: 报酬：工作与体育中的受薪／业余分界。

branches.en: SKILL: training shows as competence, and competence can stand alone as expertise.
branches.cn: 技能：训练表现为胜任，胜任又可单独成为专长。

branches.en: ETHICS: conduct is judged by the standards of the field.
branches.cn: 伦理：行为按该领域的标准被评判。

branches.en: EXTENSIONS: informal praise of quality, and an archaic euphemism that the main sense has outgrown.
branches.cn: 延伸：对品质的非正式赞美，以及主要义已使其不再适用的旧委婉语。

intro.en: Professional is profession plus -al. English adds -ly, -ism, -ize, and the negative un-, while the Latin fateri also gives confess and confession.
intro.cn: professional 是 profession 加 -al。英语加 -ly、-ism、-ize 与否定 un-，拉丁语 fateri 还生成 confess 与 confession。
